Outcome of Board Meeting — Best Agrolife Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

Bonus — Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on January 19, 2026, have alloted bonus equity shares at the ratio of 1 : 2, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held.
General Updates — Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange receipt of the In-Principal approval for bonus shares from National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited
Record Date — Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Bonus & Split/Subdivision  is 16-Jan-2026.
General Updates — Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange about sub division of face value of equity shares and bonus issue

Stock split — Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on December 03, 2025, has considered and approved subdivision of 23644740 equity shares of 10 each into 389827350 equity shares of 1 each.

Bonus — Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on December 03, 2025, have considered and approved bonus at the ratio of 1 : 2, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Best Agrolife Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.
